_comment: Static address mapping for the rekon10 fleet. Addresses, not names: the house DHCP hands
out a rotating DNS list rather than an ordered fallback, so a runtime lookup of the
internal *.local.symmatree.com names succeeds or fails by luck of the draw. See
Addresses observed 2026-09-13. These are DHCP leases, so they can move -- when one does,
this file is the one place to change.
The three unflashed campods are listed with enabled:false so the fleet roster is complete
and adding a unit is a one-word change rather than a new entry.
